verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents API keys that authenticate requests, plus endpoints to list accounts and initiate ACH, wire, book, and FedNow transfers. The pack shows no scoped or permission-limited credentials, no transfer amount caps, no counterparty allowlists, and no vendor documentation of agent use by name. The Card Auth Loop is an adjacent card-authorization control, not a policy-bound credential for account operation, so it earns no credit.
